Latest Updates

Timberline is Closed for Skiing & Snowboarding: We plan to open for the winter season as soon as there is enough snow to responsibly operate. For everyone’s safety, respect closed areas. Active machinery and unmarked hazards do exist. 

Road Conditions

Be prepared for winter driving conditions. Please drive with caution.
